build_mds_embedding: build a metric MDS embedding from a precomputed pairwise distance matrix with classical MDS initialization
build_nonmetric_mds: build a non-metric MDS embedding from noisy pairwise distances and rescale to match original data spread
build_classical_mds: build a classical MDS solution from a precomputed distance matrix using sklearn's ClassicalMDS
test_euclidean_distances: test computing pairwise Euclidean distances and adding symmetric noise to the distance matrix
run_pca_alignment: run PCA rotation and sign alignment on MDS embeddings to match original data orientation
